subject: sentences
title: And, but, or
about: He picks the joining word that makes the sentence make sense: and, but, or, because. NC L.1.6 names common conjunctions, and CKLA Unit 7 teaches and, but and or in May, so this is the last level of the year.
tip: Read the sentence with each choice in the blank and ask which one makes sense.

cards.sayQ: Sam, blank, Pam are twins. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: And joins two things that go together.

cards.sayQ: Both Ben, blank, Kim can swim. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: And joins two things that go together.
